description: Update metadata.json dependencies (incl. simp.optional_dependencies) across ALL repos in one pass: follow Forge superseded_by renames and bump upper version bounds to '< next major' when the current release is out of range. One Forge API request per unique module slug.

repo_paths.description: Paths to every repo to process (a single invocation shares the Forge lookup cache across all of them)

forge_api_url.description: Base URL of the Forge API (default: https://forgeapi.puppet.com/v3)
